description: This file defines the SelfEvaluationController class, which is part of the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It handles pre-rendering and capability checks for self-evaluation performance reviews within the HRM system, extending functionality from AdminEvaluationController and using traits for performance review services and user role management.

classes.name: SelfEvaluationController
classes.description: Controller class managing self-evaluation performance review functionalities, including pre-render setup and permission checks, extending from AdminEvaluationController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the self-evaluation component for rendering, fetching the review by ID and setting component properties.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the specified review based on their role and review status.
